# **Steps to Implement SSL COMMERZ SDK on Users Project** {#steps-to-implement-ssl-commerz-sdk-on-users-project}

## **Step 1** {#step-1}

**Users need to add below dependency to their build.gradle (app module) :**  
implementation 'com.android.support:support-compat:28.0.0'  
implementation 'com.android.support:appcompat-v7:28.0.0'  
implementation 'com.android.support:support-v4:28.0.0'  
implementation 'com.android.support:design:28.0.0'  
implementation 'com. google. code. gson: gson:2.8.5'	

## **Step 2** {#step-2}

To insert the **Dependency Mentioned in step 1**, users need to follow the below steps:  
From top left corner of project pane,   
“Select” **Project**  🡪 **app** 🡪 **libs** 🡪 “Paste” **sslCommerzSdk.aar in libs folder**

Afterwards, users need to additional codes to the project after inserting sslCommerzSdk.aar in libs folder by following steps below:

 “Select” **Project app** 🡪 **build.gradle (app module)** and add below code and **sync project**:

repositories {  
    flatDir {  
        dirs 'libs'  
    }  
}  
implementation (name: 'sslCommerzSdk', ext:'aar')

Afterwards, users need to sync the project and the below code will appear on the project pan:

## **Step 3** {#step-3}

After successfully completing SDK integration, users can request for transaction.  In order to commence transaction, users need to pass SSLCommerzInitialization. 

**SSLCommerzInitialization (Mandatory to initiate SSL Commerz):**

final SSLCommerzInitialization sslCommerzInitialization \= new SSLCommerzInitialization ("yourStoreID","yourPassword", amount, SSLCCurrencyType.BDT,"123456789098765", "yourProductType", SSLCSdkType.TESTBOX);

**Also, users can add optional field like below:**  
final SSLCommerzInitialization sslCommerzInitialization \= new SSLCommerzInitialization ("yourStoreID","yourPassword", amount, SSLCCurrencyType.BDT,"123456789098765", "yourProductType", SSLCSdkType.TESTBOX).addMultiCardName(“”).addIpnUrl(“”);

**Afterwards, user need to call below class to connect with SSLCommerz:**  
IntegrateSSLCommerz  
                .getInstance(context)  
                .addSSLCommerzInitialization(sslCommerzInitialization)  
                .buildApiCall(this);

# **Optional Initializer** {#optional-initializer}

## **Customer Initializer** {#customer-initializer}

final SSLCCustomerInfoInitializer customerInfoInitializer \= new SSLCCustomerInfoInitializer("customer name", "customer email",

                "address", "dhaka", "1214", "Bangladesh", “phoneNumber”);

## **EMI Initializer** {#emi-initializer}

final SSLCEMITransactionInitializer emiTransactionInitializer \= new SSLCEMITransactionInitializer(1);

## **Product Initializer** {#product-initializer}

final SSLCProductInitializer productInitializer \= new SSLCProductInitializer ("food", "food",  
        new SSLCProductInitializer.ProductProfile.TravelVertical("Travel", "10",  
                "A", "12", "Dhk-Syl", "N/A", "AAA",  
                "DDD"));

## **Shipment Initializer** {#shipment-initializer}

final SSLCShipmentInfoInitializer shipmentInfoInitializer \= new SSLCShipmentInfoInitializer ("Courier",  
        2, new SSLCShipmentInfoInitializer.ShipmentDetails("AA","Address 1",  
        "Dhaka","1000","BD"));

## **Additional Initializer** {#additional-initializer}

final SSLCAdditionalInitializer additionalInitializer \= new SSLCAdditionalInitializer ();  
additionalInitializer.setValueA("Value Option 1");  
additionalInitializer.setValueB("Value Option 1");  
additionalInitializer.setValueC("Value Option 1");  
additionalInitializer.setValueD("Value Option 1");

# **Method to Submit Optional Data** {#method-to-submit-optional-data}

IntegrateSSLCommerz  
        .getInstance(context)  
        .addSSLCommerzInitialization(sslCommerzInitialization)  
        .addEMITransactionInitializer(emiTransactionInitializer)  
        .addCustomerInfoInitializer(customerInfoInitializer)  
        .addProductInitializer(productInitializer)  
        .buildApiCall(this);

# **Return Type**  {#return-type}

| SL | Type | Method | Description |
| :---: | :---: | :---: | ----- |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getAPIConnect()** | API Connection Status \- **INVALID\_REQUEST** : Invalid data imputed to call the API **FAILED** : API Authentication Failed **INACTIVE** : API User/Store ID is Inactive **DONE** : API Connection Success |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getStatus()** | Return **VALID/VALIDATED** or **FAILED** status for this transaction. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getSessionkey()** | An unique session id for this transaction generated from SSLCOMMERZ gateway. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getTranDate()** | Transaction Date and time. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getTranId()** | Transaction ID that was generated and sent from Merchant-end. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getValId()** | A Validation ID against the Transaction which is provided by SSLCOMMERZ. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getAmount()** | The total Transaction Amount sent from Merchant-end including the Commissions added by SSLCOMMERZ and Bank. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getStoreAmount()** | The total Transaction Amount sent from Merchant-end. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getBankTranId()** | An unique transaction id generated by bank for this Transaction. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getCardType()** | The Bank Gateway Name that customer selected. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getCardNo()** | Customer’s Card number; only for BRAC and DBBL, not for Internet Banking. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getCardIssuer()** | Credit/Debit Card Issuer Bank/Company Name |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getCardBrand()** | Credit/Debit Card Brand Name.  Like VISA, Master etc |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getCardIssuerCountry()** | Card issuer country in full length. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getCardIssuerCountryCode()** | Card issuer country code. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getCurrencyType()** | Merchant Store Provided Currency. Like : **USD** , **BDT** |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getCurrencyAmount()** | Merchant Store Provided Amount. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getCurrencyRate()** | Without Our Default Currency(BDT) if any merchant provide Other Currency then Conversion rate will be sent.(Google Currency Rate ) |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getBaseFair()** | Merchant Store Provided Amount. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getValueA()** | If any kind of optional value. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getValueB()** | If any kind of optional value. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getValueC()** | If any kind of optional value. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getValueD()** | If any kind of optional value. |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getAPIConnect()** | Valid/Invalid (Based on Your Credentials) |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getValidatedOn()** | First Validation Date time |
|  | [**String**](http://developer.android.com/reference/java/lang/String.html) | **getGwVersion()** | Version of payment gateway. |
|  | **String** | **getRiskLevel()** | Get risk-level for this transaction. The return value will be 0 or 1\. If 0 then the transaction is safe . If 1 then the transaction is risky. |
|  | **String** | **getRiskTitle()** | Get the status of the transaction. |
